content: Treat your inferiors as you would be treated by your superiors.
author: Seneca
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

In Seneca's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
